description: This Python source file defines a configuration class for Vertex AI Gemini Image Edit within a larger machine learning framework. It includes methods for environment validation, URL construction for API calls, request transformation for image editing, and response processing to extract image data.

classes.name: VertexAIGeminiImageEditConfig
classes.description: Configuration class for managing Vertex AI Gemini image editing operations, including environment validation, request/response transformation, and URL construction.

methods.description: Filters and maps OpenAI-like parameters to the format expected by the Vertex AI Gemini API.

methods.name: Optional[str] _resolve_vertex_location(self)
methods.description: Resolves the vertex location from object attributes, environment variables, or secret manager.

methods.name: Optional[str] _resolve_vertex_credentials(self)
methods.description: Resolves the credentials for Vertex AI from object attributes, environment variables, or secret manager.

methods.name: dict validate_environment( self, headers: dict, model: str, api_key: Optional[str] = None, litellm_params: Optional[dict] = None, api_base: Optional[str] = None, )
methods.description: Validates and sets headers for making authenticated requests to Vertex AI endpoints.

methods.name: str get_complete_url( self, model: str, api_base: Optional[str], litellm_params: dict, )
methods.description: Constructs the full API URL for the Vertex AI generateContent endpoint based on model, project, and location.

methods.name: Tuple[Dict[str,Any],Optional[RequestFiles]] transform_image_edit_request( self, model: str, prompt: str, image: FileTypes, image_edit_optional_request_params: Dict[str, Any], litellm_params: GenericLiteLLMParams, headers: dict, )
methods.description: Prepares and transforms the image edit request payload and inline image data for API submission.

methods.name: ImageResponse transform_image_edit_response( self, model: str, raw_response: httpx.Response, logging_obj: Any, )
methods.description: Parses the API response to extract image content data and package it into an ImageResponse object.

methods.name: str _map_size_to_aspect_ratio(self, size: str)
methods.description: Maps a size string like '1024x1024' to an aspect ratio string like '1:1'.

methods.name: List[Dict[str,Any]] _prepare_inline_image_parts( self, image: Union[FileTypes, List[FileTypes]] )
methods.description: Prepares the inline data parts from image files, encoding images to base64.

methods.name: bytes _read_all_bytes(self, image: FileTypes)
methods.description: Reads all bytes from various image input types such as bytes, BytesIO, or BufferedReader.
